`mvn clean test -B` now passes with jcabi-aspects still at 0.25.1.

The build failed because the new version no longer has the `com.jcabi.aspects.Tv` class, and `RegionITCase.java` still imported it. I removed that import and replaced the constants with their literal values (`Tv.TEN` became `10`, `Tv.EIGHT` became `8`). Nothing else changed: no pom edits, no test removed or skipped.

I ran Maven with `-q`, so the output was just warnings and debug logging. I didn't see a test-count summary, but the run completed without any errors.
